---config---
# open_taki config
listen: ":9998"

# LLM Backend (microllm or direct vLLM)
# model = meta stage: DocMeta, Summary, Entities, Store-Detect, Rescue, Chat
llm:
  api_base: "http://localhost:8012/v1"
  model: "local"
  max_tokens: 4096

# OCR stage model (grounded bbox OCR + VLM text OCR)
# Empty = use llm.model. Point this at a fast vision model that does
# bboxes well (e.g. a 27B) while meta runs on the quality model (e.g. 122B).
ocr:
  model: ""

# Collabora — office document conversion (DOC, XLS, PPT, ODT, ODS, ODP)
# If not set, only pandoc-supported formats work (DOCX, ODT, EPUB, RTF)
# Collabora is open source and available as container: collabora/code
collabora:
  url: ""  # e.g. "http://collabora:9980"

# Whisper Backend — audio/video transcription
whisper:
  api_base: ""  # e.g. "http://localhost:8019/v1"
  model: "whisper-large-v3"

# Embedding Backend
embedding:
  api_base: ""  # e.g. "http://localhost:8019/v1"
  model: "nomic-ai/nomic-embed-text-v1.5"

# Vector DB
vector:
  url: ""  # e.g. "http://localhost:6333"
  collection: "documents"

# PDF
pdf:
  dpi: 150
  max_pages: 20

# pdftotext fallback
fallback:
  min_chars: 200
  min_chars_per_page: 50

# Structured metadata extraction from document letterheads
# Uses guided_json (constrained decoding) for deterministic extraction
# Schema, prompt and rescue prompt are loaded from external files.
# Edit those files to add/change metadata fields without rebuilding.
docmeta:
  enabled: true
  model_version: "qwen3-doctype-1.0"           # doctype model version (prompt + schema + types)
  rescue_pass: true                            # text-based fallback if vision pass incomplete
  required_fields: [doc.date, sender.company]  # trigger rescue if these are null
  schema_file: ""        # default: /etc/open_taki/docmeta_schema.json
  prompt_file: ""        # default: /etc/open_taki/docmeta_prompt.txt
  rescue_prompt_file: "" # default: /etc/open_taki/docmeta_rescue_prompt.txt
